Unique ID of the item on Grab. 
This column is required when updating an item. 
Please do not make any edit to your Item ID.
*ItemName:
Item Name 
The name of the item. 
This column can't be empty and must stay under 80 characters.
*Price:
Price 
The price of the item in local currency. 
This column can't be empty.
*CategoryName:
Category Name 
The category this item belongs to. 
This column can't be empty and must stay under 60 characters.
AvailabilitySchedule:
(Optional) Availability Schedule 
The name of scheduled availability for this item. Availability Schedule controls the service hours within a week of the categories and items under it.
If you leave it blank, will use the default schedule which will be available all time.
If you fill in a name, will locate the exisiting schedule with the name.
*AvailableStatus:
Availability Status 
Availability of the item. 
Only the following value is valid:
- AVAILABLE 
- UNAVAILABLE_TODAY
- UNAVAILABLE_PERMANENTLY

OptionGroup1:
(Optional) Option group 1 
Option group and options applicable to this item. 
To link multiple option groups to one item, add a new column of OptionGroup (Example: OptionGroup2, OptionGroup3). 

Please include the following value and use the following format to create a valid value:
-Option group name
- Minimum selection
- Maximum selection
- First option name
- Price of the first option
- Second option name
- Price of the second option

Format: Name##MinSelection-MaxSelection##OptionName1:Price#OptionName2:Price
Example: Size##1-1##Large:5#Regular:3#Small:2
